issues.problem: Two contexts (shop assistant's attitude; being lied to hurt most) fit 腹が立つ (ky003) just as well.
issues.action: Made ctx2 a casual exclamation (ほんっと頭に来る！) and replaced ctx6 with a sudden flare-up after holding it in (ついに頭に来た).

issues.problem: near diff said 気がつく is 'simply to notice', but 気がつく人 also means attentive.
issues.action: Rewrote the diff to acknowledge that sense and keep the distinction.

issues.problem: ctx2 (always considerate of those around her) and ctx6 (making it easy for juniors to speak) fit 気を配る (ky107) equally.
issues.action: Replaced with contexts showing the strain of 気を遣う: so careful of others she can't voice her opinion; couldn't leave a drinks party early out of deference to the boss.

issues.problem: ctx2 (making a refusal call is 気が重い) fits 気が進まない (ky021) equally.
issues.action: Rewrote so the call is unavoidable tomorrow and the idiom expresses dread, not reluctance.

issues.problem: Closest look-alike in the set, 目が離せない (ky044), was not in near; ctx4 (can't leave a small baby all day) fits 目が離せない as well or better.
issues.action: Added 目が離せない to near with its difference; replaced ctx4 with being unable to break off a job until it is finished.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (a walk refreshed me → 気が変わった) is not clearly wrong; a native just reads it as a change of mind, which the sentence also allows.
issues.action: Replaced with 彼に対する気が変わった (meant: my opinion of him changed), which is clearly wrong; correct form 見方/気持ちが変わった.
